text: AB Ltd (ABL) owns a cinema. Jada purchases an annual membership for the cinema. The online
application form requires her to tick a box accepting the terms and conditions. She does not read
them, and simply ticks the box. The terms and conditions state that ABL is not liable for any injuries
on its premises, and that membership cannot be cancelled after purchase.
Jada goes to the cinema and puts her coat in the cloakroom. There is a large notice in the
cloakroom stating, ‘All property is left at the owner’s risk’. At the end of the film, Jada goes to
collect her coat, but it is missing. As she is leaving the cinema, she slips on a spilt drink which has
not been cleaned up by a member of staff. Jada breaks her arm as she falls. Two months later,
Jada asks to cancel her membership because she has obtained a job abroad.
Jada makes a claim against ABL. The company states that it is not liable for her losses and she
cannot cancel her membership.
Advise Jada and ABL of their respective contractual rights and obligations [25]
OR
Adam lives in a house bought by his parents. He and his parents have a written agreement that
states that Adam can stay there until he has enough money to buy his own house. It also states
that he must keep the house clean and tidy. When his parents visit, the house is very untidy, so
they tell him to move out immediately.
Adam is now living with a friend. He sees that the local pizza company is running a promotion,
giving a free dessert with every pizza ordered. Adam orders and pays for a pizza, but when it
arrives there is no dessert. The delivery driver tells Adam that the company has run out of free
desserts.
Advise whether intention to create legal relations is present in these agreements. [25]
Section B
Answer two questions from this section.
Discuss the extent to which the rules for communicating acceptance need to be modernised. [25]
The award of specific performance and injunction guarantee justice is served.
Assess the validity of this statement. [25]
The restrictions on minors entering contracts are justified.
Assess the validity of this statement. [25]
